SOSBlue — Secure Offline-Safe Blue Messenger
Version 1.0
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Your Identity Your phone number is your identity. All messages are end-to-end encrypted using AES-256-GCM keys derived from phone numbers.
2. Three Transport Tiers
• SOSBlue Mesh — Discover nearby devices via UDP broadcast on local Wi-Fi. Messages hop through the mesh with TTL-based relay for extended range. No internet needed.
• F2P Serverless — The Wandering Fibre Engine routes encrypted packets through the mesh. Peers discover each other via UDP heartbeats every 3 seconds. Multi-hop routing with automatic deduplication.
• SMS Relay — As a last-resort fallback, messages are sent as encrypted SMS envelopes via carrier SMS. Only works with contacts you have previously chatted with via SMS.
3. Peer Discovery Devices broadcast heartbeat beacons over UDP every 3 seconds. Discovered peers appear in the nearby devices list. IP endpoints are tracked for direct unicast.
4. News Broadcasts Broadcast news to all connected peers via Mesh or F2P, or to SMS contacts only (via SMS Relay). News items appear in a dedicated feed with transport badges.
5. Offline-First No central server, no cloud, no internet required. Works entirely on local networks. Perfect for disaster zones, remote areas, or privacy-conscious users.
All messages are end-to-end encrypted.
